What changed in v6 (your 23 Nov review)

  • Names: every character name re-recorded and checked by a speech-to-text pass. Okoye, Riri, Shuri, T'Challa, M'Baku, Namor, Nakia, Wakanda and Talokan are all heard correctly; 0 of 48 narration lines flagged.
  • Sets rebuilt to match the film: funeral avenue, UN chamber, MIT walkway, Jabari hall, Shuri's lab, throne room, hangar, sea rig at night, Mayan hall, Wakanda street, river bank, bridge highway (16 new sets).
  • Real-world scale and grounding: every standing, walking and seated character checked against each set's floor line (0 failures). The UN hall now has diplomats in its chairs; nobody stands on water, tables or air.
  • Funeral: bearers walk toward camera holding the coffin with both hands, on a straight road. Chains sit in hands. Held objects (shell, oil, sign) are gripped.
  • Namor's ankle wings are attached to his feet; fish, birds and cars face the way they move; the eagle carrying Riri is bird-sized against her.
  • Bridge chase seen from behind the cars driving away; the 7:28 car scene is now a windshield view with Ross and Val in seats (hour 1, hour 5, hour 8 joke).
  • New characters fade in with a puff instead of popping; Killmonger gets a recap card. Catwalk models stay on their marks, the random kitchen door now matches the set's own fridge.
  • Voices: gag lines re-recorded with natural reference voices; weak gags at the old 4:15 and 7:39 rewritten.
  • QA: automated render check plus contact sheets every 6 s across the whole video. The remaining automated flags are film grain and letterbox bars, which I checked by eye.
